items.quote: Ihre Wünsche für den Urlaub im ersten Halbjahr tragen Sie bitte binnen 10 Arbeitstagen ab dem Briefdatum in die Liste ein; Arbeitstage sind Montag bis Freitag ohne Feiertage.
items.computation: Letter date (Briefdatum) is 18.11.2026 (Wednesday). The period runs 'ab dem Briefdatum' (from the letter date), and per §187 I BGB, since the letter date is the triggering event occurring during that day, that day itself is not counted; the period starts the next day, 19.11.2026 (Thursday). The letter defines 'Arbeitstage' explicitly as Monday-Friday excluding public holidays, so weekends and holidays are skipped when counting the 10 workdays. Counting forward: 19.11 (Thu, day1), 20.11 (Fri, day2), 21-22.11 weekend skipped, 23.11 (Mon, day3), 24.11 (Tue, day4), 25.11 (Wed, day5), 26.11 (Thu, day6), 27.11 (Fri, day7), 28-29.11 weekend skipped, 30.11 (Mon, day8), 01.12 (Tue, day9), 02.12 (Wed, day10). No public holidays in NRW fall within this window (Allerheiligen on 01.11 is before the period starts; next NRW holiday is Christmas, well after). Day 10 is 02.12.2026, a Wednesday, so no further weekend/holiday adjustment under §193 BGB is needed.
